name: upwork/cover_letter
template:
Hi {client_name},

Your project stood out because {specific_detail}. I built something close to this recently — a {similar_workflow} that does exactly that, in n8n + OpenAI.

What I can deliver:
- {deliverable_1} (e.g., a working workflow that scrapes the source, runs it through GPT-4, and writes the output to a Google Sheet)
- {deliverable_2} (e.g., Slack notification on each row, error handling for missing fields)
- {deliverable_3} (e.g., short Loom video walking through the workflow so your team can maintain it)

Timeline: {duration} days
Budget: {budget} (I bill in 2 milestones — 50% on first working version, 50% on your sign-off)

I've shipped {n_projects} similar automations. Portfolio link: {portfolio_url}

A few quick questions to make sure I understand the scope:
1. How many records/items per day will the workflow process?
2. Any specific tools (Make, Zapier, n8n) you want me to use?
3. Do you have an example input/output you'd like me to match?

Happy to do a 1-hour test task at no charge to prove the fit before you commit. Let me know if useful.

Best,
Alaa Fathi
AI Automation Engineer
rules: address the specific job (don't be generic)
